default_value.description: Default value used when a query references this variable.

is_multi.description: Whether a List variable accepts multiple selected values.

name.description: Human-readable name for the SQL variable.

type.description:
Variable type. Controls how the value is rendered and substituted in HogQL.

* `String` - String
* `Number` - Number
* `Boolean` - Boolean
* `List` - List
* `Date` - Date

values.description: Allowed values for List variables. Null for other variable types.

values_query.description: HogQL query whose first result column supplies the allowed values for a List variable. An optional second column supplies display labels.

values_query_connection_id.description: ID of the external data source connection values_query runs against. Null runs it against PostHog.
